LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.0.label: First Furrow
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.0.descriptio: Retains the chosen Harvest awakening. Refinement: crop yield or daily supplies. Fractional supplies carry over. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.1.label: Crop Rotation
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.1.descriptio: Harvest two different edible crops with the same worker within a day to hold one seed record. Their next completed sowing spends it for 15% growth. The record expires after one day. Refinement increases growth; the whole mechanism is available immediately. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.2.label: Into the Granary
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.2.descriptio: Each worker banks 15% of their actual edible crop yield. Every third successful harvest pays whole stored produce; fractions and undelivered produce stay in their account. Each contribution keeps the rate at which it was earned. Bonus produce cannot start another batch. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.3.label: Seed Selection
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.3.descriptio: After spending a rotation record on sowing, remember that crop for one day. Another rotation by the same worker on the same map, ending with a different crop, adds 15% of that native harvest. Fractions persist per worker and product; extra produce cannot trigger another harvest. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.4.label: Shared Rows
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.4.descriptio: When another colonist successfully harvests a food crop you planted, they earn 10% extra growth for their next completed food-crop sowing. Each worker can hold one reward; further harvests cannot stack or replace it. The rate is fixed when the original crop is planted. Retraining this branch clears pending rewards and invalidates earlier planting records. Refinement improves future planting records. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.5.label: Field Ingredients
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.5.descriptio: Record food harvested from sown crops for 60 days. Cooking meals with these ingredients earns up to 25% extra meals, scaled by their share of consumed food units. Only actual ingredient consumption and delivered or carried meals count. Fractions and undelivered bonuses remain with the cook, separately for each meal type. Refinement improves future cooking; old credit keeps its value. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.6.label: Separate Stores
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.6.descriptio: Successful Granary payouts bank another 125% as worker-owned reserves for that produce. Later harvests of the same produce withdraw whole units, up to 10% of the native yield per harvest (at least one unit). New deposits cannot be withdrawn by the harvest that created them. Fractions and failed deliveries persist; refinement changes only future deposits. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.7.label: Selective Breeding
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.7.descriptio: Three successful Seed Selection bonus deliveries of the same crop prepare one selected-seed record for that worker. Each delivered unit stores 3% growth, up to 3% total. Their next completed sowing of that crop spends the record for its stored growth. One ready record per worker and crop; further deliveries wait until it is spent. Refinement improves future contributions, not stored records. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.8.label: Relay Farming
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.8.descriptio: After a worker spends a Relay reward to sow a food crop, another colonist can harvest that same plant for 15% extra produce. Sowing alone, ordinary plants and harvesting your own planting do not earn the bonus. The rate is fixed at sowing. Fractions and undelivered produce stay with the harvester and pay out on later harvests of the same product. Refinement improves future cooperative plantings. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.9.label: Kitchen Shifts
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.9.descriptio: A homegrown-ingredient cooking completion starts a shift on that map. Within three days, a different colonist must complete another qualifying meal to close it. The pair earns 15% extra meals, weighted by each job's consumed homegrown share, for the second cook. Repeated jobs by the first cook add nothing and do not extend the deadline. Earned fractions and undelivered meals persist; refinement affects only future jobs. Retraining clears unfinished shifts. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.10.label: Stock Rotation
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.10.descripti: When cooking actually consumes food and delivers meals, redeem the cook's existing Separate Stores balance for matching ingredients. The redeemed share of consumed food units, multiplied by 500%, becomes extra meals. Redeemed credit is removed from Separate Stores; moving or splitting food earns nothing. Meal fractions and undelivered rewards persist. Refinement changes only future conversions, not earned meals. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.11.label: Stable Variety
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.11.descripti: Using selected seeds starts one focused crop cycle for that worker. Three consecutive successful harvests of the planted crop return 10% of their combined native yield. A different crop resets the unfinished sequence. The rate is fixed when the cycle starts; further selected sowings cannot queue or replace it. Fractions and failed deliveries persist after completion. Refinement improves future cycles. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.12.label: Mixed Breeding
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.12.descripti: Complete selected-seed sowings of three different crops with one worker to enrich their next nine successful edible harvests by 25%. Repeated crops do not advance diversity. Each cycle freezes its rate when completed; active cycles cannot stack or bank another cycle. Fractions and undelivered produce persist. Refinement improves future cycles. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.13.label: Trading Rows
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.13.descripti: Complete a cooperative cycle by returning the harvest to its first planter: A plants, B harvests and spends Relay to plant, then A harvests. A gains 5% extra growth on each of their next two food-crop sowings. Pending uses cannot stack, refresh or queue. The rate is frozen when earned; refinement improves future rewards. Retraining clears pending uses. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.14.label: Three Farming Shifts
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.14.descripti: Complete a cooperative cycle with three distinct colonists: A plants, B harvests and spends Relay to plant, then C harvests. Each participant gains 7.5% extra growth on their next food-crop sowing. Rewards belong to each worker; pending uses cannot stack or refresh. Rates are fixed when earned. Refinement improves future rewards; retraining clears pending uses. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.15.label: Consecutive Batches
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.15.descripti: A completed Kitchen Shift using the same recipe prepares a batch for the receiving cook. Their next three homegrown-ingredient completions of that recipe earn an extra 25% of their actual meal output, weighted by homegrown ingredient share. Another meal recipe clears unfinished progress. Repeated handovers cannot stack or refresh the batch. Its rate is fixed when prepared; fractions and undelivered rewards persist. Retraining clears unfinished batches. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.16.label: Varied Table
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.16.descripti: A completed Kitchen Shift prepares a table for the receiving cook. Afterwards, cook three different meal types using homegrown ingredients to settle a 30% surplus from the first completion of each type, weighted by its homegrown ingredient share. Repeats add nothing; single and bulk recipes for the same meal count as one type. Another handover cannot replace or queue an active table. Its rate is fixed when prepared. Earned fractions persist; retraining clears unfinished tables. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.17.label: Seeds from Stores
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.17.descripti: Finishing an edible crop sowing spends up to one unit of that crop's existing Separate Stores balance, belonging to the sower. Each unit adds 20% initial growth; fractional credit gives proportional growth. Only the amount that can benefit the plant is spent. This uses the same balance as Stock Rotation, so spent seed credit cannot also become meals. Refinement improves future sowings only. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.18.label: Supplies to Kitchens
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Harvest.nodes.18.descripti: A Stock Rotation conversion opens a three-day supply round on that map. Another cook must spend their own reserves containing a different crop to close it. Each cook earns 125% of their own new converted meal credit as a supplement, fixed at the time of their contribution. The first cook's repetitions and same-crop contributions cannot add value or extend the deadline. Each cook redeems their own completed rewards while cooking. Retraining clears unfinished rounds; earned fractions persist. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
